jen_customer: Hey team — our prod embeddings calls to /v1/embeddings dropped from ~12k vecs/s to ~2.1k vecs/s around 09:12 UTC. Tokens/sec stayed ~18k. We're also seeing intermittent 403s for some requests. We reproduced with curl. Sample payload attached.

alex_support: Sorry you're seeing this. Can you paste the curl (sanitized) and request headers? Which model + dim? Any recent config changes (batching/window, variant pin)?

jen_customer: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-02","input":["a","b","c"]}'
Dims reported: 512. No config changes on our side. Billing UI shows a spike at the same time.

alex_support: Got it. We're grabbing traces. One quick ask: enable debug headers (X-Redwood-Debug) on a failing request and paste back the debug headers (kvcache, batch_size, queue_len, variant, vec-rate). Also paste the 403 body when it occurs.

maria_sre: Infra telemetry shows a config rollout at 09:10 that reduced batch_window to 8ms for a small percent of traffic (experiment). Around the same time embed-pool-7's GPU queue depth climbed and we started seeing smaller batch sizes. Pulling pod metrics now.

dan_ml: Two quick hypotheses: 1) batch_window shrink -> smaller batches -> vec/sec drops while tokens/sec may remain similar; 2) variant/auth mismatch causing some requests to be rejected (403) and fall back to different routing. If dims are stable at 512 it's probably batching+backpressure rather than dim mismatch.

infra-bot: deploy-rollout rwd-config/2026-09-12-09 triggered by ops-user@redwood — batch_window change split 5/95.

alex_support: Jen, any example of a 403 response body? Also the debug headers from your failing request (if available) will help us correlate.

jen_customer: 403 body: {"error":"permission_denied","message":"account not authorized for model variant"}. Debug headers from a failed request: X-RW-Batch-Size: 1, X-RW-Queue-Len: 42, X-RW-KVCache: miss, X-RW-Vec-Rate: 1.9k.

maria_sre: Queue-len 42 + batch-size 1 is a tell: the pool is backpressuring and releasing tiny batches. The A/B config likely routed some traffic to a variant with stricter auth checks (hence occasional 403s) and also shortened batch window — double hit on throughput. We'll query auth-service logs for denies and correlate to variant ids.

dan_ml: Repro plan (I will run this): spawn 1k clients and compare embedding throughput for batch_window=40ms vs 8ms; measure vecs/sec and distribution of batch sizes. Also test pinning to stable quantized variant to see if vec-rate recovers.

alex_support: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) rollback the batch_window experiment (maria) 2) pin jen_customer's route to the stable variant until auth fix 3) temporarily increase per-pod max-concurrency to reduce queue length pressure 4) advise jen to add retries/backoff for 403/5xx in client. I'll open an internal incident and coordinate.

maria_sre: Rolling back the experiment now and notifying ops. Also creating an escalation to auth-team for the permission_denied trace.

billing-bot: Alert: billing meter anomaly for account jen-corp detected at 09:12 (delta +450%). Auto-invoice hold engaged pending investigation.

jen_customer: Thanks — appreciate the quick loop. I will run Dan's repro and attach the request traces + our rate curve. Anything else you need from my side?

alex_support: Attach: 1) sample failing request/response (with debug headers) 2) your client-side RPS/vecs/sec curve around the incident 3) any recent API key rotations. We'll keep updates here and confirm rollback impact.
